vi.B: Hãy nói với dân Y-sơ-ra-ên: 'Ai nguyền rủa Đức Chúa Trời của mình thì phải gánh lấy hậu quả của tội mình.
vi.R: Hãy bảo dân Y-sơ-ra-ên: 'Nếu ai nguyền rủa Đức Chúa Trời, người ấy có tội và sẽ bị phạt vì tội đó.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 자손에게 너는 말하여 일러라. '누구든지, 누구든지 자기 하나님을 저주하면, 그는 자기 죄를 짊어질 것이다.
ko.B: 이스라엘 백성에게 이렇게 일러라. '누구든지 자기 하나님을 저주하면, 그는 자기 죄의 값을 치를 것이다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 사람들에게 일러라. '누구든지 하나님을 저주하면 그 사람은 죄가 있으므로 그 죄 때문에 벌을 받을 것이다.

decisions.choice: a man, a man: anyone at all
decisions.reason: Doubling the word means "any person whatever", as in 17:3, 8 and 20:2. Verse 16 shows that it includes the outsider as well as the Israelite, and the law applies to women as well as men.

decisions.choice: curses his God: treats God with contempt
decisions.reason: The verb is the one in verse 11 (see m3 there). The object is "his God", using the general word for God; verse 16 then speaks of the personal name, the LORD. Verses 15 and 16 may be one law, with verse 16 stating the penalty, or two cases, with cursing God left to God's own judgment and blaspheming the name punished with death. The text does not settle which.

decisions.choice: bear his sin: carry the guilt and its punishment
decisions.reason: To bear one's sin is to be answerable for it and suffer its consequences (17:16; 19:8; 20:20; 22:9). Here verse 16 states what the consequence is.

decisions.choice: bear the consequences of their sin; is guilty and will be punished
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "bear his sin". Balanced says "bear the consequences", as in 17:16, and Readable says plainly that the person is guilty and will be punished. Balanced and Readable use "they" or "that person" for someone who may be a man or a woman.

decisions.choice: {{gender:Cualquiera|Todo hombre}} (L); {{gender:alguien|algún hombre}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Gender setting as in English, on the noun only; the verbs and "su" are the same for both wordings, and Readable says "esa persona", as the English says "that person".

decisions.choice: {{gender:Quiconque|Tout homme qui}} (L); {{gender:quelqu’un|un homme}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Gender setting as in English, on the noun only. French has no neutral pronoun, so "il" and "son" serve both wordings; Readable says "cette personne", as the English says "that person".

decisions.choice: "누구든지" for "a man, a man" (Literal "누구든지, 누구든지"), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "누구든지" already means anyone, man or woman, so there is no second wording for the gender setting to choose; Literal repeats it to keep the doubled Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "자기 죄를 짊어지다" for "bear his sin" at Literal; "죄의 값을 치르다" at Balanced
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew image of carrying the sin; Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does.

source.text: וְנֹקֵ֤ב שֵׁם־יְהוָה֙ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֔ת רָג֥וֹם יִרְגְּמוּ־ב֖וֹ כָּל־הָעֵדָ֑ה כַּגֵּר֙ כָּֽאֶזְרָ֔ח בְּנָקְבוֹ־שֵׁ֖ם יוּמָֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And one who blasphemes [the] name of Yahweh surely will be put to death; surely will stone him all the congregation; as [the] sojourner, so [the] native, when he blasphemes [the] Name he will be put to death.

en.L: And whoever blasphemes the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} shall surely be put to death; all the congregation shall surely stone him. As the sojourner, so the native: when he blasphemes the Name, he shall be put to death.
en.B: Whoever blasphemes the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} must be put to death. The whole congregation must stone that person. The outsider is no different from the native-born: whoever blasphemes the Name must die.
en.R: Anyone who insults the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} must be put to death. All the people must kill that person by throwing stones. This is true for strangers and for people born in Israel. Anyone who insults the Name must die.

es.L: Y el que blasfeme contra el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, sin falta se le dará muerte; toda la comunidad sin falta lo apedreará. Tanto el inmigrante como el nativo: cuando blasfeme contra el Nombre, se le dará muerte.
es.B: Quien blasfeme contra el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} será condenado a muerte. Toda la comunidad tendrá que apedrear a esa persona. El extranjero no es distinto del israelita de nacimiento: quien blasfeme contra el Nombre morirá.
es.R: Cualquiera que insulte el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} debe ser condenado a muerte. Todo el pueblo tiene que matar a esa persona tirándole piedras. Esto vale para los extranjeros y para los que nacieron en Israel. Cualquiera que insulte el Nombre tiene que morir.

fr.L: Et celui qui blasphème le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} sera certainement mis à mort ; toute la communauté le lapidera certainement. L’immigré comme l’autochtone : s’il blasphème le Nom, il sera mis à mort.
fr.B: Quiconque blasphème le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} sera mis à mort. Toute la communauté devra lapider cette personne. L’étranger n’est pas différent de l’Israélite de naissance : quiconque blasphème le Nom doit mourir.
fr.R: Toute personne qui insulte le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} doit être mise à mort. Tout le peuple doit la tuer en lui jetant des pierres. Cela vaut pour les étrangers comme pour les gens nés en Israël. Toute personne qui insulte le Nom doit mourir.

sw.L: Na mwenye kulikufuru jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa hakika atauawa; jumuiya yote kwa hakika itampiga mawe. Mgeni kama mwenyeji: atakapolikufuru Jina, atauawa.
sw.B: Yeyote atakayelikufuru jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atauawa. Jumuiya yote itampiga mawe mtu huyo. Mgeni hana tofauti na Mwisraeli kwa kuzaliwa: yeyote atakayelikufuru Jina lazima afe.
sw.R: Mtu yeyote anayelitukana jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lazima auawe. Watu wote lazima wamuue kwa kumpiga mawe. Sheria hii ni kwa wageni na kwa watu waliozaliwa Israeli. Mtu yeyote anayelitukana Jina lazima afe.

vi.L: Kẻ nào phạm thượng đến danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chắc chắn phải bị xử tử; cả hội chúng chắc chắn phải ném đá người ấy. Ngoại kiều thế nào, người bản xứ cũng thế ấy: khi người ấy phạm thượng đến Danh, người ấy phải bị xử tử.
vi.B: Ai phạm thượng đến danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phải bị xử tử. Cả hội chúng phải ném đá người ấy. Ngoại kiều cũng như người bản xứ: ai phạm thượng đến Danh thì phải chết.
vi.R: Ai xúc phạm danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phải bị xử tử. Cả dân chúng phải ném đá người đó cho đến chết. Luật này áp dụng cho cả ngoại kiều lẫn người sinh ra trong Y-sơ-ra-ên. Ai xúc phạm Danh thì phải chết.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 모독하는 자는 반드시 죽임을 당해야 한다. 온 회중이 반드시 그를 돌로 쳐야 한다. 나그네나 본토인이나 마찬가지로, 그 이름을 모독하면 그는 죽임을 당해야 한다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 모독하는 자는 반드시 죽여야 한다. 온 회중이 그를 돌로 쳐야 한다. 나그네라도 본토인과 다를 바 없다. 그 이름을 모독하는 자는 누구든지 죽어야 한다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 모욕하는 사람은 누구든지 사형에 처해야 한다. 모든 사람이 그에게 돌을 던져 죽여야 한다. 이 법은 이스라엘에 사는 나그네에게도, 이스라엘에서 태어난 사람에게도 똑같이 적용된다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 모욕하는 사람은 누구든지 죽어야 한다.

decisions.choice: blasphemes the name of the LORD: speaks against Yahweh's name with contempt
decisions.reason: The verb of verse 11 (see m1 there). This verse names the Name in full, "the name of the LORD", and so explains "the Name" of verses 11 and 16b.

decisions.choice: surely be put to death; surely stone: the sentence is certain and must be carried out
decisions.reason: Each verb is doubled with a form of itself, which makes it emphatic. "He shall surely be put to death" is the standard form of a death sentence in the law (20:2, 9; Exodus 21:12, 15-17).

decisions.choice: as the sojourner, so the native: the law holds for both alike
decisions.reason: The sojourner is a person of another people living among Israel (see 16:29; 19:10); the native is one born an Israelite. The man of verse 10 had an Egyptian father, and this clause settles that he too is bound by the law against blaspheming the LORD's name. Verse 22 makes the principle general.

decisions.choice: insults
decisions.reason: Readable says "insults" for "blasphemes", a more common word, as in verse 11. Literal and Balanced keep "blasphemes".

decisions.choice: el inmigrante como el nativo (L); el extranjero ... el israelita de nacimiento (B)
decisions.reason: Literal pairs "el inmigrante" and "el nativo" as Exodus 22 and Numbers 15 do; Balanced says "el israelita de nacimiento" to make clear whose native-born is meant.

decisions.choice: l'immigré comme l'autochtone (L); l'étranger ... l'Israélite de naissance (B)
decisions.reason: Literal pairs "l'immigré" and "l'autochtone" as Exodus 22 and Numbers 15 do; Balanced says "l'Israélite de naissance", since the native here is one born in Israel, not a native of any land.

decisions.choice: mgeni ... mwenyeji (L); Mwisraeli kwa kuzaliwa (B)
decisions.reason: "Mgeni" is the settled word for the sojourner; Literal pairs it with "mwenyeji" (native), and Balanced says "Mwisraeli kwa kuzaliwa", as in Numbers 15.

decisions.choice: "나그네" for the sojourner and "본토인" for the native (Readable "이스라엘에서 태어난 사람")
decisions.reason: "나그네" is the term sheet's word for the *ger*; "본토인" is the plain word for someone born in the land.

decisions.choice: "ngoại kiều" (sojourner) and "người bản xứ" (native)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's word for the ger, a foreigner who lives among Israel, as in Genesis and Joshua; "người bản xứ" is the ordinary word for someone born in the land.

source.text: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּ֥י יַכֶּ֖ה כָּל־נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֑ם מ֖וֹת יוּמָֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And [a] man, if he strikes down any life of humankind, surely he will be put to death.

en.L: And {{gender:anyone|a man}} who strikes down any human life shall surely be put to death.
en.B: {{gender:Anyone|Any man}} who strikes and kills another human being must be put to death.
en.R: If {{gender:anyone|any man}} kills another person, the killer must be put to death.

es.L: Y si {{gender:alguien|un hombre}} hiere de muerte a cualquier vida humana, sin falta se le dará muerte.
es.B: {{gender:Cualquiera|Todo hombre}} que golpee a otro ser humano y lo mate será condenado a muerte.
es.R: Si {{gender:alguien|algún hombre}} mata a otra persona, el asesino debe ser condenado a muerte.

fr.L: Et si {{gender:quelqu’un|un homme}} frappe [à mort] toute vie humaine, il sera certainement mis à mort.
fr.B: {{gender:Quiconque|Tout homme qui}} frappe un autre être humain et le tue sera mis à mort.
fr.R: Si {{gender:quelqu’un|un homme}} tue une autre personne, le meurtrier doit être mis à mort.

sw.L: Na mtu atakayeupiga uhai wowote wa mwanadamu, kwa hakika atauawa.
sw.B: Mtu yeyote atakayempiga mwanadamu mwingine na kumuua atauawa.
sw.R: Mtu akimuua mtu mwingine, lazima muuaji auawe.

vi.L: Người nào đánh chết bất cứ mạng người nào chắc chắn phải bị xử tử.
vi.B: Ai đánh chết một người khác phải bị xử tử.
vi.R: Nếu ai giết một người khác, kẻ giết người phải bị xử tử.

ko.L: 그리고 누구든지 사람의 목숨을 쳐서 죽이면, 그는 반드시 죽임을 당해야 한다.
ko.B: 누구든지 다른 사람을 쳐서 죽이면, 그는 반드시 죽여야 한다.
ko.R: 누구든지 다른 사람을 죽이면, 죽인 사람도 사형에 처해야 한다.

decisions.choice: strikes down any human life: kills a human being
decisions.reason: "Strike" with "life" as its object means to strike so as to kill (Genesis 37:21; Deuteronomy 19:6). The life of a human being may not be taken, because humankind is made in God's image (Genesis 9:5-6; Exodus 21:12).

decisions.choice: surely be put to death: the penalty for murder
decisions.reason: The law elsewhere distinguishes a deliberate killing from an accidental one, which is not punished by death (Exodus 21:13-14; Numbers 35:9-34; Deuteronomy 19:1-13). This verse does not repeat that distinction; it states the basic rule.

decisions.choice: anyone: the law applies to every person, outsider or native
decisions.reason: As in verse 15, the word "man" here means anyone, and verse 22 applies these laws to the outsider and the native-born alike.

source.text: וּמַכֵּ֥ה נֶֽפֶשׁ־בְּהֵמָ֖ה יְשַׁלְּמֶ֑נָּה נֶ֖פֶשׁ תַּ֥חַת נָֽפֶשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And one who strikes down [the] life of [an] animal will repay it, life in place of life.

en.L: And whoever strikes down the life of an animal shall repay it, life for life.
en.B: Whoever kills an animal belonging to someone else must replace it: life for life.
en.R: If someone kills an animal that belongs to someone else, they must pay for it by giving the owner another animal.

es.L: Y el que hiera de muerte la vida de un animal la restituirá: vida por vida.
es.B: Quien mate un animal que pertenece a otro tiene que reponerlo: vida por vida.
es.R: Si alguien mata un animal que es de otra persona, tiene que pagarlo dándole al dueño otro animal.

fr.L: Et celui qui frappe à mort la vie d’une bête la restituera : vie pour vie.
fr.B: Quiconque tue une bête appartenant à quelqu’un d’autre devra la remplacer : vie pour vie.
fr.R: Si quelqu’un tue un animal qui appartient à une autre personne, il doit le payer en donnant au propriétaire un autre animal.

sw.L: Na mwenye kuupiga uhai wa mnyama atalipa: uhai kwa uhai.
sw.B: Yeyote atakayemuua mnyama wa mtu mwingine atalipa mnyama mwingine badala yake: uhai kwa uhai.
sw.R: Mtu akimuua mnyama wa mtu mwingine, lazima alipe kwa kumpa mwenye mnyama mnyama mwingine.

vi.L: Kẻ nào đánh chết mạng một con thú phải bồi thường nó, mạng thay mạng.
vi.B: Ai giết chết con vật của người khác phải bồi thường: mạng thay mạng.
vi.R: Nếu ai giết con vật của người khác, người đó phải đền cho chủ một con vật khác.

ko.L: 그리고 짐승의 목숨을 쳐서 죽인 자는 그것을 갚아야 한다. 목숨에는 목숨으로.
ko.B: 남의 짐승을 죽인 사람은 그것을 물어 주어야 한다. 목숨에는 목숨이다.
ko.R: 누구든지 남의 짐승을 죽이면, 그 주인에게 다른 짐승을 주어서 갚아야 한다.

decisions.choice: repay it: make good the loss to its owner
decisions.reason: The verb means to make whole or complete. In the law it is used for compensating an owner for an animal or property lost by someone else's fault (Exodus 21:34-36; 22:5-6, 14).

decisions.choice: life for life: an equal replacement for what was lost
decisions.reason: The phrase means a living animal in place of the one killed, or its value. The same words are used of human life in Exodus 21:23, and verses 19-21 build on the same idea of equal measure.

decisions.choice: belonging to someone else
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say the animal belongs to someone else. The verb "repay" shows that the law concerns a loss to another owner, not the slaughter of one's own animals.

source.text: וְאִ֕ישׁ כִּֽי־יִתֵּ֥ן מ֖וּם בַּעֲמִית֑וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה כֵּ֖ן יֵעָ֥שֶׂה לּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And [a] man, if he puts [a] blemish on his fellow, just as he has done, so it will be done to him.

en.L: And if {{gender:anyone|a man}} puts a blemish on his fellow, just as he has done, so it shall be done to him.
en.B: If {{gender:anyone|a man}} injures a neighbor, what they did is to be done to them.
en.R: If {{gender:anyone|a man}} hurts another person and leaves a lasting injury, the same thing must be done to the one who caused it.

es.L: Y si {{gender:alguien|un hombre}} causa un defecto [físico] a su prójimo, como él hizo, así se le hará.
es.B: Si {{gender:alguien|un hombre}} hiere a su prójimo, se le hará lo mismo que hizo.
es.R: Si {{gender:alguien|un hombre}} hiere a otra persona y le deja una lesión permanente, hay que hacerle lo mismo al que la causó.

fr.L: Et si {{gender:quelqu’un|un homme}} cause un défaut [physique] à son prochain, comme il a fait, ainsi il lui sera fait.
fr.B: Si {{gender:quelqu’un|un homme}} blesse son prochain, on lui fera ce qu’il a fait.
fr.R: Si {{gender:quelqu’un|un homme}} blesse une autre personne et lui laisse une blessure durable, il faut faire la même chose à celui qui l’a causée.

sw.L: Na mtu akimtia jirani yake kilema, kama alivyofanya, ndivyo atakavyofanyiwa.
sw.B: Mtu akimjeruhi jirani yake, atatendewa kama alivyotenda.
sw.R: Mtu akimuumiza mwenzake na kumwachia jeraha la kudumu, lazima yeye aliyesababisha atendewe vivyo hivyo.

vi.L: Nếu người nào làm cho người lân cận mình mang tật, người ấy đã làm thế nào thì sẽ bị làm lại cho người ấy thế ấy:
vi.B: Nếu ai gây thương tích cho người lân cận, người ấy đã làm gì thì phải chịu lại y như vậy:
vi.R: Nếu ai làm người khác bị thương và để lại tật suốt đời, thì người gây ra thương tích ấy phải chịu lại đúng như vậy.

ko.L: 그리고 누구든지 자기 이웃에게 상처를 입히면, 그가 한 대로 그에게 해야 한다.
ko.B: 누구든지 이웃에게 상처를 입히면, 그가 한 그대로 그에게도 해야 한다.
ko.R: 누구든지 다른 사람을 다치게 해서 몸에 상처를 남기면, 다치게 한 사람에게도 똑같이 해야 한다.

decisions.choice: a blemish: a lasting bodily injury
decisions.reason: The word is the one used for the defects that make an animal unfit for an offering and a priest unfit to serve at the altar (21:17-23; 22:20-25). So it means a permanent injury or maiming, such as the loss of an eye or a tooth (verse 20), not a passing hurt.

decisions.choice: his fellow: another member of the community
decisions.reason: The word means a companion or fellow citizen (5:21; 19:11, 15, 17). With verse 22, it covers anyone who lives among the people.

decisions.choice: just as he has done, so it shall be done to him: the penalty matches the harm
decisions.reason: This states the principle that verse 20 spells out: the punishment is measured by the injury done.

decisions.choice: leaves a lasting injury
decisions.reason: Readable says "leaves a lasting injury" to give the sense of "blemish" (see m1). Literal keeps "blemish"; Balanced says "injures".

decisions.choice: un defecto [físico]
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "defecto", the word for the defects of animals and priests in chapters 21-22 (see m1), and brackets "físico", which Spanish needs to make it a bodily injury.

decisions.choice: un défaut [physique]
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "défaut", the word used for the defects of animals and priests in chapters 21-22 (see m1), and brackets "physique", which French needs to make it a bodily injury.

decisions.choice: kilema
decisions.reason: Literal says "kumtia kilema", to leave someone maimed, which is the sense of the Hebrew "blemish" here (see m1); "kasoro" (defect) would not read as an injury done to a person.

decisions.choice: "상처" for the Hebrew "blemish"
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew word is the "defect" (흠) of an animal; here it is an injury to a person, and "흠을 내다" would sound like damage to an object in Korean.

source.text: שֶׁ֚בֶר תַּ֣חַת שֶׁ֔בֶר עַ֚יִן תַּ֣חַת עַ֔יִן שֵׁ֖ן תַּ֣חַת שֵׁ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֥ן מוּם֙ בָּֽאָדָ֔ם כֵּ֖ן יִנָּ֥תֶן בּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: fracture in place of fracture, eye in place of eye, tooth in place of tooth; just as he puts [a] blemish on [a] person, so it will be put on him.

en.L: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; just as he puts a blemish on a person, so it shall be put on him.
en.B: a broken bone for a broken bone, an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth. The same injury they caused to someone else is to be caused to them.
en.R: A broken bone for a broken bone, an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth. Whatever injury someone causes, the same injury must be done to them.

es.L: fractura por fractura, ojo por ojo, diente por diente; como él cause un defecto a una persona, así se le causará a él.
es.B: hueso roto por hueso roto, ojo por ojo, diente por diente. La misma lesión que haya causado a otro se le causará a él.
es.R: Un hueso roto por un hueso roto, un ojo por un ojo, un diente por un diente. Cualquier daño que alguien cause, el mismo daño se le tiene que hacer a él.

fr.L: fracture pour fracture, œil pour œil, dent pour dent ; comme il aura causé un défaut à quelqu’un, ainsi il lui en sera causé un.
fr.B: os brisé pour os brisé, œil pour œil, dent pour dent. La blessure qu’il a faite à autrui, on la lui fera à lui.
fr.R: Un os cassé pour un os cassé, un œil pour un œil, une dent pour une dent. Quelle que soit la blessure qu’on cause à quelqu’un, on doit subir la même blessure.

sw.L: kuvunjika kwa kuvunjika, jicho kwa jicho, jino kwa jino; kama alivyomtia mtu kilema, ndivyo atakavyotiwa.
sw.B: mfupa uliovunjika kwa mfupa uliovunjika, jicho kwa jicho, jino kwa jino. Jeraha alilomsababishia mwenzake ndilo atakalosababishiwa yeye.
sw.R: Mfupa uliovunjika kwa mfupa uliovunjika, jicho moja kwa jicho moja, jino moja kwa jino moja. Jeraha lolote mtu analomsababishia mwenzake, lazima naye atendewe vivyo hivyo.

vi.L: gãy thay gãy, mắt thay mắt, răng thay răng; người ấy đã gây tật cho một người thế nào, thì sẽ bị gây lại cho người ấy thế ấy.
vi.B: gãy xương đền gãy xương, mắt đền mắt, răng đền răng. Người ấy đã gây thương tích cho người khác thế nào thì phải chịu lại thương tích như thế.
vi.R: Gãy xương đền gãy xương, mắt đền mắt, răng đền răng. Ai gây thương tích gì cho người khác thì phải chịu lại đúng thương tích ấy.

ko.L: 골절에는 골절로, 눈에는 눈으로, 이에는 이로 [갚아야 한다]. 그가 사람에게 상처를 입힌 대로 그에게도 그렇게 해야 한다.
ko.B: 뼈를 부러뜨렸으면 뼈를, 눈을 다치게 했으면 눈을, 이를 부러뜨렸으면 이를 그렇게 해야 한다. 남에게 입힌 상처를 그대로 그에게도 입혀야 한다.
ko.R: 뼈를 부러뜨렸으면 뼈를, 눈을 다치게 했으면 눈을, 이를 부러뜨렸으면 이를 그렇게 해야 한다. 누구든지 남에게 입힌 상처는 똑같이 자기도 받아야 한다.

decisions.choice: an eye for an eye: the punishment must equal the injury and go no further
decisions.reason: The rule sets a limit. Punishment may not be greater than the harm done: one eye for one eye, not a life for an eye. It stands against unlimited revenge such as Lamech's boast in Genesis 4:23-24. It is a rule for judges in a court, not permission for private revenge: Deuteronomy 19:15-21 applies it after the judges have examined the witnesses, and 19:18 forbids taking revenge on a fellow Israelite. The same rule of equal measure applies to rich and poor, outsider and native (verse 22). Jesus quotes it in Matthew 5:38-42.

decisions.choice: so it shall be put on him: how the rule was applied is not stated here
decisions.reason: The verse states the principle of equal measure. The law itself allows payment in place of an injury in some cases: a slave who loses an eye or a tooth goes free (Exodus 21:26-27), and an injured man is paid for his lost time (Exodus 21:18-19). Numbers 35:31 forbids taking a payment for the life of a murderer, but says nothing like this for injuries. Later Jewish law applied the rule as payment of the value of what was lost. The text here does not say whether the penalty was carried out in kind or paid as its value.

decisions.choice: fracture for fracture: the same rule as Exodus 21:23-25 and Deuteronomy 19:21
decisions.reason: The formula appears three times in the law. Here it adds "fracture" (a broken bone) and is set in the middle of laws on killing people and animals (verses 17-21).

decisions.choice: a broken bone
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "a broken bone" for "fracture", a plainer word. Literal keeps the short Hebrew pattern "fracture for fracture".

decisions.choice: "뼈를 부러뜨렸으면 뼈를, 눈을 다치게 했으면 눈을..." at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the short proverbial form; Balanced and Readable spell out the rule so that it reads as the matching penalty the meaning decision describes.

source.text: וּמַכֵּ֥ה בְהֵמָ֖ה יְשַׁלְּמֶ֑נָּה וּמַכֵּ֥ה אָדָ֖ם יוּמָֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And one who strikes down [an] animal will repay it, and one who strikes down [a] human will be put to death.

en.L: And whoever strikes down an animal shall repay it, and whoever strikes down a human shall be put to death.
en.B: To kill an animal means paying for it; to kill a person means being put to death.
en.R: A person who kills an animal must pay for it. But a person who kills another human must be put to death.

es.L: Y el que hiera de muerte a un animal lo restituirá, y al que hiera de muerte a un ser humano se le dará muerte.
es.B: Matar un animal obliga a pagarlo; matar a una persona se castiga con la muerte.
es.R: Si alguien mata un animal, tiene que pagarlo. Pero si alguien mata a otra persona, debe ser condenado a muerte.

fr.L: Et celui qui frappe à mort une bête la restituera, et celui qui frappe à mort un être humain sera mis à mort.
fr.B: Qui tue une bête la paie ; qui tue un être humain est mis à mort.
fr.R: Celui qui tue un animal doit le payer. Mais celui qui tue une autre personne doit être mis à mort.

sw.L: Na mwenye kumpiga mnyama atalipa, na mwenye kumpiga mwanadamu atauawa.
sw.B: Kuua mnyama ni kulipa; kuua mwanadamu ni kuuawa.
sw.R: Mtu anayeua mnyama lazima alipe. Lakini mtu anayeua mwanadamu mwingine lazima auawe.

vi.L: Kẻ nào đánh chết một con thú phải bồi thường nó; kẻ nào đánh chết một người phải bị xử tử.
vi.B: Giết một con vật thì phải đền; giết một người thì phải bị xử tử.
vi.R: Ai giết một con vật phải đền cho chủ. Nhưng ai giết một người phải bị xử tử.

ko.L: 그리고 짐승을 쳐서 죽인 자는 그것을 갚아야 하고, 사람을 쳐서 죽인 자는 죽임을 당해야 한다.
ko.B: 짐승을 죽인 사람은 그 값을 물어 주면 되지만, 사람을 죽인 사람은 죽여야 한다.
ko.R: 짐승을 죽인 사람은 그 값을 갚아야 한다. 그러나 사람을 죽인 사람은 사형에 처해야 한다.

decisions.choice: a human life cannot be repaid like an animal's
decisions.reason: The verse sums up verses 17-18. An animal can be replaced, but a human being, made in God's image, cannot; so the law allows no payment for a murderer's life (Numbers 35:31-33; Genesis 9:6).

decisions.choice: the laws are set in a ring around "an eye for an eye"
decisions.reason: Verses 17-21 run: killing a person (17), killing an animal (18), injury (19-20), killing an animal (21a), killing a person (21b). The rule of equal measure in verse 20 stands at the center, and the repeated laws frame it.

decisions.choice: To kill an animal means paying for it
decisions.reason: Balanced sets the two cases side by side as short parallel clauses, which show the contrast. Literal keeps "whoever strikes down".

source.text: מִשְׁפַּ֤ט אֶחָד֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כַּגֵּ֥ר כָּאֶזְרָ֖ח יִהְיֶ֑ה כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Judgment one will be for you; as the sojourner, as the native it will be; for I [am] Yahweh your God.

en.L: One judgment shall be for you; as the sojourner, so the native shall be; for I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.'"
en.B: There is to be a single standard of justice for you, the same for outsider and native-born alike, for I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.'"
en.R: The same rule is for everyone, both strangers and people born in Israel. I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God.'"

es.L: Un mismo juicio habrá para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}; como el inmigrante, así será el nativo; porque yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios”».
es.B: Habrá una sola norma de justicia para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, la misma para el extranjero y para el israelita de nacimiento, porque yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios”».
es.R: La misma norma es para todos, tanto para los extranjeros como para los que nacieron en Israel. Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios”».

fr.L: Il y aura pour vous un seul jugement ; l’immigré comme l’autochtone, il en sera ainsi ; car je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu.” »
fr.B: Il y aura pour vous une seule règle de justice, la même pour l’étranger et pour l’Israélite de naissance, car je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu.” »
fr.R: La même règle vaut pour tout le monde, pour les étrangers comme pour les gens nés en Israël. Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu.” »

sw.L: Hukumu moja itakuwa kwenu; kama mgeni, ndivyo mwenyeji atakavyokuwa; kwa kuwa {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu.'"
sw.B: Mtakuwa na kipimo kimoja cha haki, kilekile kwa mgeni na kwa Mwisraeli kwa kuzaliwa, kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu.'"
sw.R: Sheria ni ileile kwa kila mtu, kwa wageni na kwa watu waliozaliwa Israeli. Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu.'"

vi.L: Một luật xét xử sẽ dành cho các ngươi; ngoại kiều thế nào, người bản xứ cũng thế ấy; vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi.'"
vi.B: Các ngươi phải có cùng một chuẩn mực công lý, áp dụng như nhau cho ngoại kiều và người bản xứ, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi.'"
vi.R: Cùng một luật áp dụng cho mọi người, cả ngoại kiều lẫn người sinh ra trong Y-sơ-ra-ên. Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi.'"

ko.L: 너희에게는 한 가지 법도가 있어야 한다. 나그네나 본토인이나 마찬가지이다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님이기 때문이다.'"
ko.B: 너희에게는 나그네와 본토인을 가리지 않는 하나의 법도가 있어야 한다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님이다.'"
ko.R: 나그네이든 이스라엘에서 태어난 사람이든 모두에게 같은 법이 적용되어야 한다. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 너희 하나님이다.'"

decisions.choice: one judgment: a single legal standard for all
decisions.reason: The word means a legal ruling or the justice it gives. One standard is to govern the outsider and the Israelite alike, in these laws on blasphemy, killing and injury. Other laws say the same (Exodus 12:49; Numbers 15:15-16, 29).

decisions.choice: for I am the LORD your God: the reason for equal justice
decisions.reason: The one God of Israel gives one law to everyone who lives among his people (see 18:2; 19:34). The outsider is under his protection and under his law alike.

decisions.choice: a single standard of justice; the same rule
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "one judgment". Balanced says "a single standard of justice", and Readable "the same rule", since "judgment" here means the law as applied, not one court decision.

decisions.choice: "법도" for *mishpat* (judgment, rule)
decisions.reason: The term sheet keeps "법도" for *mishpat* and "규례" for statute, so that the pair can be told apart through Leviticus.

decisions.choice: "나는 주 너희 하나님이다" for "I am the LORD your God"
decisions.reason: The name stands next to "나는" and "너희 하나님" follows as its apposition, so that the divine_name setting changes only the name.

decisions.choice: "một luật xét xử" (one judgment)
decisions.reason: Here mishpat means the standard by which cases are judged, not one rule among many, so the term sheet's "mạng lệnh" is not used; Balanced says "chuẩn mực công lý".

source.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁה֮ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיּוֹצִ֣יאוּ אֶת־הַֽמְקַלֵּ֗ל אֶל־מִחוּץ֙ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַיִּרְגְּמ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ אָ֑בֶן וּבְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עָשׂ֔וּ כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And spoke Moses to [the] sons of Israel, and they brought out the one who cursed to outside of the camp, and they stoned him [with] stone[s]; and [the] sons of Israel did just as had commanded Yahweh Moses.

en.L: And Moses spoke to the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, and they brought the one who had cursed outside the camp and stoned him [with] stones; and the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel did just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.B: Moses passed this on to the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}, and they brought the man who had cursed out of the camp and killed him with stones. The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} did exactly what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.R: Moses told the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said. So they took the man who had cursed outside the camp. There they threw stones at him until he died. The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} did just what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

es.L: Y habló Moisés a los hijos de Israel, y sacaron al que había maldecido fuera del campamento y lo apedrearon con piedras; y los hijos de Israel hicieron tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.B: Moisés transmitió esto a los israelitas, y ellos sacaron del campamento al hombre que había maldecido y lo mataron a pedradas. Los israelitas hicieron exactamente lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.R: Moisés les dijo a los israelitas lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho. Entonces llevaron fuera del campamento al hombre que había maldecido. Allí le tiraron piedras hasta que murió. Los israelitas hicieron tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había mandado a Moisés.

fr.L: Et Moïse parla aux {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël, et ils firent sortir hors du camp celui qui avait maudit et le lapidèrent avec des pierres ; et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël firent comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.B: Moïse transmit cela aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, et ils emmenèrent hors du camp l’homme qui avait maudit et le tuèrent à coups de pierres. Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} firent exactement ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.R: Moïse a dit aux {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait dit. Alors ils ont emmené hors du camp l’homme qui avait maudit. Là, ils lui ont jeté des pierres jusqu’à ce qu’il meure. Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ont fait exactement ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait ordonné à Moïse.

sw.L: Na Musa akasema na wana wa Israeli, nao wakamtoa yule aliyelaani nje ya kambi, wakampiga kwa mawe; na wana wa Israeli wakafanya kama vile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.B: Musa aliwapa Waisraeli agizo hilo, nao wakamtoa nje ya kambi mtu yule aliyelaani, wakamuua kwa mawe. Waisraeli walifanya sawasawa na vile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.R: Musa aliwaambia Waisraeli yale ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amesema. Kwa hiyo wakampeleka nje ya kambi mtu yule aliyelaani. Huko wakampiga mawe mpaka akafa. Waisraeli walifanya kama vile {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.

vi.L: Môi-se nói với con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên, và họ đem kẻ đã nguyền rủa ra ngoài trại quân và lấy đá ném người ấy; con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên làm đúng như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền cho Môi-se.
vi.B: Môi-se truyền lại điều ấy cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên. Họ đem người đã nguyền rủa ra khỏi trại quân và ném đá người ấy chết. Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên làm đúng y như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền cho Môi-se.
vi.R: Môi-se nói cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên biết điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán. Vậy họ dẫn người đã nguyền rủa ra ngoài khu trại. Tại đó họ ném đá anh ta cho đến chết. Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên làm đúng như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền cho Môi-se.

ko.L: 그리고 모세가 이스라엘 자손에게 말하자, 그들이 저주한 자를 진 바깥으로 끌어내어 그를 돌로 쳤다. 이스라엘 자손은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모세에게 명령하신 대로 행했다.
ko.B: 모세가 이 말씀을 이스라엘 백성에게 전하자, 그들은 저주한 자를 진 밖으로 끌어내어 돌로 쳐 죽였다. 이스라엘 백성은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모세에게 명령하신 그대로 했다.
ko.R: 모세는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 말씀을 이스라엘 사람들에게 전했다. 그러자 그들은 저주한 사람을 진 밖으로 데리고 나갔다. 그리고 거기서 그에게 돌을 던져 죽였다. 이스라엘 사람들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모세에게 명령하신 그대로 했다.

decisions.choice: they did just as the LORD had commanded Moses: the ruling is carried out at once
decisions.reason: The chapter ends with the people obeying the ruling exactly. Like the story of Nadab and Abihu (10:1-7) and the Sabbath-breaker (Numbers 15:32-36), a real case shows that God's holiness and his law apply among his people.

decisions.choice: stoned him with stones: put him to death by stoning
decisions.reason: The noun repeats the verb for emphasis, as in 20:2, 27. It means that the sentence of verse 14 was carried out.

decisions.choice: passed this on; told ... what the LORD had said
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "Moses spoke to the sons of Israel". Balanced and Readable say what he spoke about: the ruling of verses 14-22.
